name: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 & SaMD Medical Software Compliance
description: Compliance framework for US FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures) and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) FDA guidance, covering system validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), dual-manifest electronic signatures, audit trails, and computer software assurance (CSA).
owner: FDA Regulatory Affairs & Life Sciences Quality Assurance

checklists.name: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 & SaMD Validation Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for 21 CFR Part 11 Subparts B & C requirements and FDA SaMD guidelines.

items.statement: System validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) establishes that the computerized system fulfills its intended purpose (§11.10(a)).
Computer-generated audit trails record the date, time, user ID, and previous values for all electronic record modifications (§11.10(e)).
Electronic signatures bind two distinct components (e.g. password + token) and display printed name, timestamp, and intent (§11.50).
Access is restricted to authorized individuals using unique user IDs and strong authentication (§11.10(d)).
Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) hazard analysis and IEC 62304 software lifecycle documentation are completed.

reviewGates.name: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Quality Assurance Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Regulatory Quality Assurance Director confirms that computer system validation, electronic signatures, and Part 11 audit trails meet FDA standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the system validation package confirm full compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and SaMD requirements?
